transcriber_notes: Rows: 5 year rows (昭和 8-12; 同 expanded) + 6 支廳 rows as printed. The title 漁船 is split across the gutter/page (漁 ... 船); 漁船 is the printed heading over the whole table.
Totals: 總數 = 動力ヲ有セサルモノ + 動力ヲ有スルモノ, each 總數 = sum of its sub-columns, in all 11 rows (reconciles). The 6 支廳 rows sum to the 昭和 12 row in every column (reconciles).
Row 'パラオ支廳', col '乘組員': last digit slightly smudged, read 2,903; the 乘組員 column of the 支廳 rows sums to the printed 5,500 only with 3 (3-vs-8 rule; candidate 2,908 does not reconcile).
Row 'サイパン支廳', col '總數': first digit slightly smudged, read 129 (= 89 + 40).

en.d: Gives the number of fishing boats at year end, without engines by tonnage class and with steam or motor engines by tonnage class, by year from 1933 to 1937, with the 1937 figures by branch office.
